description: This file defines the TaxRateDao interface, which declares methods for accessing tax rate data related to merchant stores, countries, zones, tax classes, and languages in the system.

classes.name: TaxRateDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to TaxRate entities, extending generic DAO functionality.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of tax rates associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Fetches tax rates based on country, state or province, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Provides a specific tax rate identified by a code within a merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns tax rates for a store filtered by language.
